outline: 本課程以提升學生英文能力，至全民英檢中級以上的程度為目標。教學內容以加強學生日常生活中，如：購物、旅遊、定餐等用語之溝通、運用、表達及閱讀寫作等能力為主。
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. Sentence Writing
3. TOEIC Reading 1
4. TOEIC Reading 2
5. TOEIC Reading 3
6. TOEIC Reading 4
7. TOEIC Reading 5
8. TOEFL Reading
9. Midterm
10.Newspaper Reading
11. Newspaper Reading
12. CNN Star Reporter
13. Building the Bottle
14. Dialogue
15. Dialogue
16. Black: The Enduring Fashion
17. Table & Figure Writing
18. Abstract Writing
assessment:
Attendance:10%
Midterm: 30%
Quiz: 15%
Final Project:30%
In-class assignment: 15%
